sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 660. Success value 100. 3x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Abstraction for 40 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Applies Field Protect to the allied Field.
-Target: all allies. Applies Diffusion. The next Ability used will change from a specified single/range target to targeting all (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Grace for 120 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Revolutionary Element (increases max HP by 100%, increases all stats by 100%, increases Ability Power of critical hits by 30, and reduces Ability Cost consumption by 50%) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 35000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 40.
Wind and Light Defense from Unison Damage +600
